answer_verbatim:
If you want the **best online courses** for learning shadow work and spiritual practice, the strongest options in your results are **Jung Platform’s *Encounters with the Shadow*** for a psychologically grounded approach, **Awake Academy’s course directory** for a broader blend of shadow work and contemplative practice, and **DailyOM’s *The Shadow Work Method to Heal*** for a more guided, intuitive style.[5][12][18]

A practical way to choose is by *style*:

| Course | Best for | Why it stands out |
|---|---|---|
| **Encounters with the Shadow** (Jung Platform) | Jungian shadow work | It is described as an in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work and part of a Jungian psychology series.[5] |
| **Shadow courses** (Jung Platform) | Deeper Jungian study | The platform offers six in-depth courses and talks with lifetime access, aimed at depth and authenticity.[8] |
| **The Shadow Work Method to Heal** (DailyOM) | Guided healing and reflection | The course uses an 8-module format focused on uncovering psychological and energetic barriers.[18] |
| **Awake Academy course directory** | Spiritual practice + shadow work | It combines shadow work, mindfulness, Western psychology, insight training, and Tibetan Buddhism.[12] |
| **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** (Udemy) | Practice-heavy self-study | It includes lessons, exercises, meditations, prayers, and practices for spiritual transformation.[17] |
| **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** (Udemy) | Beginner-friendly self-mastery | It emphasizes integrating the shadow self, hidden gifts, self-mastery, and spiritual awakening.[3] |

If you want a more **traditional spiritual + psychological** blend, **Awake Academy** looks like the closest match because it explicitly combines shadow work with mindfulness and Tibetan Buddhism.[12] If you want a more **Jungian / depth-psychology** route, **Jung Platform** is the most clearly aligned.[5][8]

A few other notable options from your results:
- **Centre of Excellence – Shadow Mastery Diploma Course**: focuses on discovering hidden or denied parts of yourself and integrating them with compassion and awareness.[4]
- **Personal Development School – Overcoming Unworthiness & Accepting Your Shadow**: a shorter structured course with 12 lessons and 3.5 hours of video.[13]
- **Zachary Phillips – Hunt Your Own Shadow**: a free 12-week self-paced course focused on limiting beliefs, unresolved trauma, and hidden patterns.[16]
- **Catherine Liggett – Shadowwork 101**: a 5-week live Zoom course with practical techniques used in the instructor’s own practice.[11]

If you want, I can next rank these by **best for beginners**, **best for spiritual practice**, or **best free options**.
